name: Cleansing Reunion: target player banishes three cards from their graveyard
notes: Engine bug fix: Cleansing Reunion (xpnjvt9y59) is an ACTION card, but its ability was authored in the CardEditor ability database under the 'Enter' macro (557 other cards correctly use this for a permanent's on-enter trigger, dispatched via $enterAbilities/QueueEnterTriggeredAbility) instead of 'CardActivated' (824 cards; the table OnCardActivated()'s unconditional final dispatch at GameLogic.php ~5365 actually reads from, for every activated card regardless of type). Since an ACTION card never enters the field as a permanent, $enterAbilities['xpnjvt9y59:0'] was simply never invoked -- playing the card normally resolved it straight to the graveyard with the ability silently never running. Root-caused via DevTools/fix-cleansing-reunion-macro-classification.php, which corrects this one card's row (macro_name 'Enter' -> 'CardActivated') through the CardAbilityRepository API; GeneratedMacroCode.php (gitignored) must be regenerated afterward (php zzGameCodeGenerator.php rootName=GrandArchiveSim) for the closure to move into $cardActivatedAbilities. 755 other ACTION cards already used 'CardActivated' correctly, confirming this was a per-card authoring mistake, not a systemic dispatch bug -- no change was made to OnCardActivated() itself, matching the instruction not to special-case ACTION-card dispatch generally. Cleansing Reunion is WIND element (not native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion), so the champion's Subcards are patched with a WIND champion (Spirit of Wind, pNiyaGlIe7) to unlock element access, same technique as deployment-beacon-summon-drone. It also carries Imbue 2, which inserts a YESNO 'reveal reserved cards?' decision before the normal 2-reserve MZCHOOSE payment loop; answered NO here (declining Imbue is out of scope for this fixture). FOLLOW-UP FIX: the ability's first banish-target MZCHOOSE used to be written in the CASTER's frame ('theirGraveyard-N'), which player 2 resolved against player 1's graveyard, banishing Cleansing Reunion itself. The override in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php writes it in the opponent's own frame (myGraveyard-N), so all three picks now banish player 2's cards.

rulesClauses: Target player banishes three cards from their graveyard.
